title: Logical Fallacies
description: Name the flaw in the reasoning.

cards.front: Attacking the person making the argument instead of the argument
Misrepresenting someone's argument to make it easier to attack
Claiming something is true because it has not been proven false
Presenting only two options when more exist
Assuming one small step inevitably leads to a chain of disasters
Treating a link between two events as proof that one produced the other
Using the conclusion as one of the premises
Claiming something is true because many people believe it
Citing a famous name outside their field as proof
Generalising from a sample far too small to support it
Shifting the definition of a term mid-argument
Redefining a category to dismiss any counterexample
Introducing an irrelevant topic to divert the argument
Demanding the other side disprove your unsupported claim
Judging a decision by its outcome rather than the information available at the time
